unit: City Form Lab (Department of Urban Studies and Planning)

labs.pi_title: Head of the City Design and Development Group; Associate Professor (with tenure) of Urban Science and Planning, MIT DUSP
labs.location: MIT, 77 Massachusetts Ave., Room 10-404, Cambridge, MA 02139
labs.research_summary: Studies the influence of urban form on sustainable travel behavior and the public qualities of built environments -- urban ground floors, main streets and amenity location patterns -- using spatial analytics and the Urban Network Analysis framework the lab develops.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 PI, 4 researchers (PhD/Master's students: Liu Liu, Freya Tan, Keara Dennehy, Mohamed Elgohary), 10 collaborators (PhD students, postdocs and visiting researchers, several based at partner institutions: Aziz Alhassan, Justin Kollar, Helen Tera, Adrian Helmut Georges, Rounaq Basu, Maryam Hosseini, Nicola Colaninno, Dylan Halpern, Raul Kalvo, Chu Li)
